# EduAssist.AI

> Personal CBSE AI tutor for students from Grade 1 to Grade 12. Doubt solving, notes, quizzes, flashcards, mind maps, worksheets and revision planning aligned to NCERT.

EduAssist.AI is a learning platform built for Indian CBSE classrooms. It offers a conversational AI tutor, quiz and flashcard generators, mind maps, printable worksheets, a revision planner, and a Pomodoro focus mode. Content adapts to the student's class and follows the NCERT syllabus.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of EduAssist.AI, features and supported subjects.
- [AI Chat Tutor](/chat): Conversational tutor for solving doubts step-by-step.
- [Quizzes](/quiz): Generate CBSE-style quizzes for any chapter.
- [Flashcards](/flashcards): Spaced-repetition flashcards on any topic.
- [Revision](/revision): Personalised revision summaries.
- [Mind Maps](/mindmap): AI-generated mind maps for chapters and topics.
- [Worksheets](/worksheet): Printable practice worksheets.
- [Planner](/planner): Study plan and Pomodoro focus tools.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to the student, teacher or parent portal.
